blankets

× × ×

Every blanket is handmade and one of a kind. Before it’s packaged and ready to be gifted, I wash it with unscented baby detergent and tumble dry it on low with an unscented dryer sheet. Each blanket also comes with a swatch for baby to hold when it’s too warm for the full blanket, unless the listing says otherwise.

a little about me

Hi! I’m Lizz Southern, the maker behind Southern Stitched. My love for crochet started when I was a child, thanks to my incredibly talented mom. I picked it back up as an adult, starting mostly with blankets, then decided to try amigurumi—and promptly fell in love with that too.

I share my home with my beautiful wife, two dogs, and two cats. Despite the truly impressive amount of fur that comes with that crew, I keep my workspace very clean. Before I start, I lint-roll and disinfect the entire area—including myself—and all of my supplies stay tucked away in containers, safely out of reach of wandering paws.

Every blanket is washed with unscented baby detergent, tumble-dried on low with unscented dryer sheets, then packaged and ready to be gifted.

I’m always open to trying something new. If you don’t see exactly what you’re looking for, please reach out! There are all kinds of wonderful animals and ideas out there for amigurumi, and just because I haven’t listed one yet doesn’t mean I can’t give it a go.

Thank you for stopping by and supporting my handmade creations. Every piece is made with care, attention to detail, and a whole lot of love.
